mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_code, position, hire_date, salary, gender, married, skill, hobby, memo FROM ds_emp ORDER BY emp_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT emp_id, emp_name, dept_code, position, hire_date, salary, gender, married, skill, hobby, memo FROM ds_emp WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_emp ( emp_id, emp_name, dept_code, position, hire_date, salary, gender, married, skill, hobby, memo ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{empName}, #{deptCode}, #{position}, #{hireDate}, #{salary}, #{gender}, #{married}, #{skill}, #{hobby}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ds_emp SET emp_name = #{empName}, dept_code = #{deptCode}, position = #{position}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, salary = #{salary}, gender = #{gender}, married = #{married}, skill = #{skill}, hobby = #{hobby}, memo = #{memo} WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
